tldr: Mercury through the 7th house clarifies partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 7th house, it puts language around partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
